definition_translations.ja_JP: 短時間の後に；まもなく

senses.gloss: in a brief or rude manner
senses.example: She answered shortly and returned to her work.

example_translations.ko_KR: 그녀는 퉁명스럽게 대답하고 다시 일로 돌아갔다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Cô ấy trả lời cộc lốc rồi quay lại làm việc.
example_translations.th_TH: เธอตอบอย่างห้วน ๆ แล้วกลับไปทำงานต่อ
